name: What should I consider when selecting body spray systems for my bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when selecting body spray systems for my bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting body spray systems, consider your preferred shower experience, available water pressure, and the overall design of your luxury bathroom. Key decision factors include the number of spray heads, their adjustability, and the desired flow rate. You'll also want to choose finishes that complement your existing or planned fixtures. AKN Design Group evaluates your home's plumbing infrastructure to ensure adequate water pressure and volume, as insufficient supply can diminish performance. We guide you through options like flush-mount versus surface-mount designs and help integrate smart controls for a truly personalized and cohesive spa-inspired bathroom.
